description:
Cross-surface gates carry classified known_divergences (e.g. ClickBench Q18's
order-less LIMIT, _H2ODB_KNOWN_DIVERGENCES). These entries are reported but do
NOT fail the gate when they no longer reproduce. That asymmetry lets a stale
exception linger: once a known divergence is silently resolved (by a loader fix,
a query change, or a comparator improvement), the baseline entry stays, and a
FUTURE regression on that same cell would be masked as "known" instead of caught.

Add baseline hygiene: a known-divergence entry whose cell now matches must either
fail the gate or force a baseline update (an --update-baseline discipline), so the
exception list cannot drift ahead of reality. This mirrors the empty-baseline,
fail-on-divergence discipline the TPC-Havoc gates already enforce, extended to the
"resolved exception" direction.

anti_patterns.dont: silently auto-prune resolved entries on a normal run
anti_patterns.why: default to FAIL so the removal is a reviewed change; auto-prune only behind an explicit --update-baseline.

preserves.behavior: A new unclassified divergence still fails the gate (no weakening of detection).
Genuine, still-reproducing classified divergences (e.g. ClickBench Q18 order-less LIMIT) remain accepted.
ResultValidator semantics unchanged; reuse, do not fork.

verifications.expected: a resolved-but-listed known_divergences entry fails the gate; a still-reproducing one is accepted; a new unclassified divergence fails

verifications.command: add a fake resolved entry to a gate's known_divergences, run `make ssb-cross-surface-equivalence-report`
verifications.expected: gate FAILS naming the resolved entry; passes again once removed (or under --update-baseline)

work_units.notes:
In the gate runner, after comparison, check each known_divergences entry: if
the cell it names now MATCHES (no divergence), that entry is stale. Default
behavior: FAIL the gate with a clear message naming the resolved entry and
instructing removal; provide an --update-baseline (or make target flag) to
drop resolved entries deterministically. Keep genuine, still-reproducing
classified divergences accepted exactly as today. Apply to every gate carrying
known_divergences.
work_units.summary: Detect resolved-but-listed known divergences and fail (or require --update-baseline)
